decisions.reason: Locates upper-only/lower-only branches emitting fg only, leaving stale SGR background to paint the empty half; fix adds ESC[49m (or RESET+fg) per half-filled cell; row-end reset noted too late; tied to edge symptoms, renderer blamed not emulator or art.

Explains trailing-space trim plus pipeline trimming so narrower rows never overwrite surplus columns; proposes full-width rows plus ESC[K erase (and height-variance erase); RESET does not erase; SGR state kept controlled; pipeline accounted for.

tail2 identified as hand-ported with 23 changed cells, visible ~6-cell cluster distinguished from full diff; drift separated from renderer artifacts; different-frame excerpt test explained as blind to unsampled complement; all-frame digest manifest against source art proposed.

Mounted CI hosts never unmount, planner re-arms referenced setTimeout handles pinning the loop; TTY/stdin keeps the interactive product alive; unref each newly scheduled timeout so animation continues without keeping probes alive; CI timeout extension not proposed.

Checklist consolidates per-cell SGR completeness, full-width/erase, digest-pinned all-frame integrity, timer lifecycle; pre-default-on audit covers timers and mounting hosts including never-unmounting probes, with an exit/liveness regression and duration guard; no execution required.

caps.reason: Final advice resets half-cell background, replaces trimming with full-width+erase, mandates source-backed digests, and unrefs the planner timer; emulator not blamed.
